name: rotating neck stretch
description: Turning your head slowly from side to side stretches the muscles around the neck. It is a gentle way to ease stiffness.
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly turn your head to one side, then to the other, as far as is comfortable.
Keep your chin level and avoid pushing into any pain.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
